questions.scenario: An agent called a function with an order number the user never provided.
questions.question: Which evaluator highlights this problem?

options.why: It compares against a ground truth answer.
It looks for copyrighted content.
Correct. It judges whether the tool calls and their arguments were correct.
It scores language quality.

questions.explanation: Tool call accuracy examines the calls the agent made.

questions.scenario: An agent answered a question about invoices when the user wanted to cancel an order.
questions.question: Which evaluator measures whether the agent understood the user’s goal?

options.why: It measures logical flow of text.
It checks harmful content.
It checks retrieval quality, not agent intent.
Correct. It checks whether the agent identified and addressed the intent.

questions.explanation: Intent resolution measures understanding of what the user wanted.

questions.scenario: An agent was told to always ask for the order number, but it answered without asking.
questions.question: Which evaluator measures adherence to the instructions?

options.why: Correct. It checks whether the agent followed its assigned task and rules.
It checks the response against the query only.
It checks harm.
It compares with ground truth text.

questions.explanation: Task adherence checks that the agent kept to instructions and scope.

questions.scenario: An evaluation of 200 agent runs shows 30 failures.
questions.question: What should the team do next?

options.why: It removes visibility.

options.text: Group the failures by cause, fix the instructions or tools, and rerun the same dataset
options.why: Correct. Error analysis leads to fixes that can be measured.

options.text: Delete the failing rows from the dataset
options.why: It hides the problems.
It rarely fixes systematic failures.

questions.explanation: Error analysis finds causes, and a rerun proves the fix.

questions.scenario: A deployed agent must be checked for quality drift on real traffic.
questions.question: Which approach should you use?

options.text: A higher max output tokens value
options.why: It does not measure quality.
Quota does not measure quality.

options.text: Continuous evaluation on a sample of live traffic with alerts
options.why: Correct. It scores production conversations regularly.

options.text: A one-time evaluation before release only
options.why: It cannot detect later drift.

questions.explanation: Monitoring includes ongoing evaluation, not just pre-release tests.
